title: b1.7.3 Book And Quill
description: this mod add Book And Quill and Written Book to b1.7.3
body:
This Mod add *Book And Quill* and *Written Book* to b1.7.3. based on how it work in 1.3.1 with some new feature, notably double page book screen similiar to bedrock

The double page book screen are optional, so you can change it back to classic java style screen inside config screen if you have GlassConfigAPI and ModMenu Babric install

_(the Risugami's ModLoader version is currently outdated so the info don't apply here)_

![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60c1859b5b180b200e2814b109854624f3a04b08.png)

# Recipe

Crafting recipe for book and quill is the same as modern Minecraft

![Book And Quill Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c65096ff1bce0bb4f7daf75b6de7f13e2cfc27e9.png)

You can also make a copy of written book aswell

![Book Copy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07d606d355c7c0c99d175517a49e59d835def0b7.png)

# Requirement

Require [Babric](https://babric.github.io/) and [StationAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/stationapi) for StationAPI version

Require [ModLoader](https://mcarchive.net/mods/modloader?gvsn=b1.7.3) and [ItemNbt](https://github.com/MartinSVK12/retrostorage/releases/download/a1.5pre1/b1.7.3_ItemNBT_1.2.zip) for RML version and Forge is need for book cloning
